description:
The SWIFT & Payments platform supports mission-critical global payment processing and financial messaging services. As the organization continues its transformation toward cloud-native architectures, ISO 20022 adoption, and enhanced operational resilience, this role will provide the technical leadership necessary to ensure secure, reliable, and scalable solutions that meet business and regulatory requirements.
 What we value 
 The following skills will help you succeed in this role:
 Strong experience with SWIFT messaging and global payments.
 Deep understanding of distributed systems, messaging platforms, APIs, and middleware technologies.
 Experience with Azure cloud technologies and cloud migration strategies.
 Strong knowledge of Kafka, MQ, integration platforms, and event-driven architectures.
 Expertise in high-availability, resiliency, and disaster recovery design.
 Proven ability to lead complex technical initiatives across large organizations.
 Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making capabilities.
 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
 Experience managing critical production platforms in a financial services environment.
 Responsibilities: 
 Lead the design, delivery, and support of SWIFT and payment processing platforms.
 Drive architecture and technical design decisions across strategic initiatives.
 Establish engineering standards, best practices, and operational controls.
 Ensure alignment with enterprise technology and security standards.
 Partner with business stakeholders to translate requirements into technology solutions.
 Own platform availability, resiliency, and performance.
 Support internal and external audits.
 Maintain strong governance over production changes and operational risk management.
    
 Education & Preferred Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.
 12+ years of technology experience with progressive leadership responsibilities.
 Experience supporting SWIFT, payments, treasury, or financial messaging solutions.
 Experience with Azure cloud platform and modern DevOps practices.
 Knowledge of ISO 20022, payment networks, and financial industry regulations preferred.
 Willing to learn and support Swift network interface software applications including Linux , cloud hosted and Legacy Tandem applications.
 Knowledge of Swift business is a plus.
 
 Salary Range: 
$90,000 - $157,500 Annual 
 The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ. 
 
 Employees are eligible to participate in State Street’s comprehensive benefits program, which includes: our retirement savings plan (401K) with company match; insurance coverage including basic life, medical, dental, vision, long-term disability, and other optional additional coverages; paid-time off including vacation, sick leave, short term disability, and family care responsibilities; access to our Employee Assistance Program; incentive compensation including eligibility for annual performance-based awards (excluding certain sales roles subject to sales incentive plans); and, eligibility for certain tax advantaged savings plans. 
 For a full overview, visit https://hrportal.ehr.com/statestreet/Home .
